text:
I could not find the exact standalone "cash and cash equivalents" line item (separate from restricted cash) on Sea's balance sheet in the retrieved excerpts, despite searching the balance sheet, liquidity discussion, and market-risk sections.

What the report does clearly state: as of December 31, 2025, Sea Limited held **US$6.4 billion (US$6,419,467 thousand) in cash, cash equivalents and restricted cash combined**, up from US$4.1 billion at the end of 2024 [Sea, FY2025, p.106-107; p.141]. The notes confirm cash equivalents consist of cash on hand, demand deposits, and money market funds, while restricted cash is held mainly in escrow for the Shopee e-commerce and Monee digital financial services businesses [Sea, FY2025, p.F-30]. However, the specific split between the unrestricted "cash and cash equivalents" figure and the "restricted cash" figure was not present in the passages retrieved, so I cannot give the precise unrestricted-cash-only balance.
